Occupancy conflict requires equal channels, although actor, custody, attachment and legal constraints still apply. The two proximal ordered thigh/lower-leg surfaces have retained coverages 0.94 and 0.65 respectively; the checked projection maps their lower-leg intervals to approximately [0.5,0.94) and [0.5,0.65). By static arithmetic alone sample 0.8 is covered by linen and not mail. At an overlapping sample, strategic pairs summed layer resistance/padding with mail identity/material whereas tactical returns mail-only surface values. Authored linen protection 2/3 and mail 70/30 show nonzero distinct values before condition effects; actual actor, sampling and resulting impacts not observed.
